claude.sample_unit: model responses (60 synthetic scenarios x 3 models x 2 prompt arms x 3 repetitions)

links.outcome: Guideline concordance and unsafe major errors in ASCCP management, by scenario complexity
links.effect: Error rates rose from 3.1% in low-complexity to 29% in high-complexity scenarios; DeepSeek V3.2 unsafe major error-free rate was 75% under guideline-directed prompt.
links.quote: Error rates increased substantially with scenario complexity, rising from 3.1% in low-complexity to 29% in high-complexity scenarios.

links.outcome: Effect of guideline-directed prompt package versus baseline prompt on safety and concordance
links.effect: Guideline-directed prompt package associated with higher odds of unsafe major error-free performance (OR 3.76, 95% CI 2.45-5.77) and exact concordance (OR 8.27, 95% CI 4.14-16.52).
links.quote: In the main-effects model, the guideline-directed prompt package was associated with higher odds of both unsafe major error-free performance (odds ratio [OR] 3.76, 95% CI 2.45-5.77; P<.001) and exact concordance (OR 8.27, 95% CI 4.14-16.52; P<.001).

links.outcome: Safety and concordance with guideline-directed prompt package versus baseline prompt
links.effect: Guideline-directed prompting improved unsafe major error-free performance (OR 3.76) and exact concordance (OR 8.27).
links.quote: The guideline-directed prompt package was associated with improvement in both safety and guideline concordance, but even the best-performing model remained vulnerable in complex, history-dependent scenarios.

openai.sample_unit: LLM responses to synthetic clinical scenarios

links.outcome: Unsafe major error-free and exact concordance
links.effect: Guideline-directed prompting improved unsafe major error-free performance: OR 3.76, 95% CI 2.45-5.77; exact concordance: OR 8.27, 95% CI 4.14-16.52.
links.quote: In the main-effects model, the guideline-directed prompt package was associated with higher odds of both unsafe major error-free performance (odds ratio [OR] 3.76, 95% CI 2.45-5.77; P<.001) and exact concordance (OR 8.27, 95% CI 4.14-16.52; P<.001).

links.outcome: Unsafe major error-free rate by model
links.effect: Under guideline-directed prompting: GPT-5.3 100% (95% CI 94%-100%), Gemini 98.9% (95% CI 94%-99.8%), DeepSeek 75% (95% CI 63.2%-84%).
links.quote: Under the guideline-directed prompt package, the unsafe major error-free rate was 100% (95% CI 94%-100%) for GPT-5.3, 98.9% (95% CI 94%-99.8%) for Gemini 3 Flash, and 75% (95% CI 63.2%-84%) for DeepSeek V3.2.
